description: This file is a C header (.h) defining exported API functions for the TLS App Connector component, including function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization of TLS-related objects.

methods.name: TlsCreateAppConnector
methods.description: Creates an application connector handle for TLS.

methods.name: TlsAcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new TLS App Connector object.

methods.name: TlsAcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the TLS App Connector object.

methods.name: TlsAcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers necessary objects within the TLS App Connector.

methods.name: TlsAcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the TLS App Connector object.
